source.author: verg
source.text: Quin aspera Iuno, quae mare nunc terrasque metu caelumque fatigat, consilia in melius referet, mecumque fovebit Romanos rerum dominos gentemque togatam:
source.text_original: Quin aspera Iuno, / quae mare nunc terrasque metu caelumque fatigat, / consilia in melius referet, mecumque fovebit / Romanos rerum dominos gentemque togatam: /
source.text_english: Surely harsh Juno, who now harasses sea and lands and heaven with fear, will turn her plans to the better and will support with me the Romans, masters of the world, and the toga-wearing race:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hinc Danaum de fine sedet gentesque fovebo mox alias.
reuse.text_original: hinc Danaum de fine sedet gentesque fovebo / mox alias.
reuse.text_english: from here I sit at the end of the Danaans, and soon I shall cherish other nations as well
